testability.instructions: Judging only the supplied changed requirement/doc section (including its referenced requirement definitions): is the changed statement testable?

criteria.testable: Deterministic, observable behavior a test can verify as written
criteria.partially-testable: Some verifiable behavior, but parts are subjective or unspecified
criteria.non-testable: No observable behavior to verify (aspiration, commentary, or pure description)
criteria.ambiguous: Wording permits materially different implementations, so no single test could verify it

contradiction.instructions: Judging only the supplied changed section against the other supplied contract excerpts: does the changed statement contradict another supplied contract?

criteria.true: The changed statement and another supplied excerpt cannot both hold
criteria.false: No supplied excerpt conflicts with the changed statement

non_canonical_term.instructions: Judging only the supplied changed section and the supplied canonical glossary headings: does the changed statement use a domain term that is not canonical in the supplied glossary terms?

criteria.true: A domain concept is named with a term absent from the supplied canonical glossary terms
criteria.false: All domain terms used are canonical or the section introduces and defines its term

completeness.instructions: Judging only the supplied changed requirement/doc section: what completeness gap does it have?

criteria.complete-behavior: Success, failure, and boundary behavior are all specified
criteria.missing-success-case: A success-path behavior is not specified
criteria.missing-boundary: Edge or boundary behavior is not specified
criteria.scope-unclear: The statement's applicability (what it covers) is unclear

doc_sync.instructions: Judging only the supplied changed section together with the other supplied contract excerpts (README, glossary, architecture): is the documentation synchronized?

criteria.synchronized: Other supplied excerpts agree with the changed statement
criteria.implementation-only-drift: The change exists only in implementation-facing docs and user docs were not updated
criteria.readme-drift: The supplied README excerpt contradicts the change
criteria.glossary-drift: The supplied glossary excerpt contradicts the change
criteria.architecture-drift: The supplied architecture excerpt contradicts the change
